goal: Render the complete chat transcript and searchable conversation history in a screen-space canvas HUD with bounded long-history rendering and session-only per-conversation/per-canvas drafts.
non_goals: Do not implement Task 13 speech, TTS or AI breathing state.
Do not change Task 11 generation transaction ordering or Task 10 canvas-context persistence.
Do not add chat nodes to CanvasDocument or transform the HUD with React Flow.
Do not change retrieval, AI permissions, credentials, recovery or release behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Collapsed HUD shows deterministic latest user and assistant excerpts; expanded height is bounded by visible canvas height and 560 pixels.
Expanded transcript reuses ChatContent rendering, preserves per-conversation scroll state and windows long histories in deterministic 40-message segments.
Searchable history is bounded to 360 by 420 pixels and routes protected actions through the Task 11 store boundary.
Session-only unsent drafts are keyed by conversation or temporary session plus canvas ID, are never stored in chats or sync, and clear only after successful send or explicit clear.
HUD wheel, escape and outside-click behavior remains isolated from React Flow and chat token updates do not recreate CanvasEditor.
Focused tests, Canvas regression, TypeScript, production build and diff checks pass.
Implementation is committed, independently reviewed and passes the L2 post-edit impact gate.
do_not_touch: canvas geometry, collision or rich-media modules
remote repositories before the Phase C push gate
notes: Use test-first implementation and keep review/report evidence concise.
Reuse the existing message renderer and Task 11 protected action boundary.
Keep HUD state session-only and outside CanvasDocument and persisted chat rows.
Use fixed UTF-8 I/O for non-ASCII reads and edits.
Never inspect, print, log or modify configured provider secrets.
